title: Unwind the objectstack#7176 striped/bordered/virtualScroll forwarding chain (types → react spec-bridge → plugin-list → plugin-view → app-shell) + drop ObjectGrid.component.yml's retired declarations
body:
Filed and claimed by the `repo:objectui` seat (session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`, 2026-08-14). Pre-bump adaptation card (1 of 2) for #4636 / PR #4639, from that dev's measured enumeration; graded straight to dispatch: it is a contract pull-back (the spec retired the keys; objectui still declares/forwards them), auto-adjudicable class, and it blocks the pin bump.

## Context

objectstack#7176 (maintainer-ruled 2026-08-10, landed as objectstack PR #8252) retired `list.striped` / `list.bordered` / `list.virtualScroll` from the spec — measured pass-through-only in objectui: every reader copied the key onward and `ObjectGrid` never applied it. In `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` (GA) they are `retiredKey()` tombstones that actively reject; on the rc.6 pin main currently carries, they still parse — which is why this card can land BEFORE the bump and keep main green on both pins.

On the GA branch (PR #4639) this surfaces as: `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts(67,7)` TS2322 (`virtualScroll`), and the spec's own tombstone note traces the reader chain: react spec-bridge → plugin-list → plugin-view / app-shell, terminating at `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:1766-1838` (line refs from the GA-branch measurement — re-verify on your worktree).

Also in scope (cross-seat notice from the `domain:spec` seat, 2026-08-13, recorded on the seat post objectstack#6025): `packages/components/metadata/ObjectGrid.component.yml:45,49` still **declares** `striped` and `bordered` with defaults no implementation reads. With the upstream keys retired, delete the declarations (an implementation card filed first is the only route back, per the ruling's own text).

## Acceptance

- No objectui source declares, forwards, types, or tests the three retired keys as live surface; genuinely-invalid-shape refusal assertions (if any pin the tombstone behavior) are kept verbatim.
- Green on current main (rc.6 pin). State in the PR body which files came off the chain and confirm `pnpm exec vitest run` over the touched packages + the p1-spec-alignment suite.
- This is a user-visible authoring-surface removal in published packages ⇒ changeset required.
